title: Korean Crypto x AI Catalog Resource
description: One resource = one file under data/resources/*.yaml. Every field is machine-checked by scripts/validate.py.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the filename (without .yaml) and be globally unique.

category.description: Must be a key defined in data/categories.yaml.

publisher_relation.description: official = run by the entity it represents (e.g. an exchange's own repo); government = public-sector body; community = third party; maintainer = affiliated with this catalog's maintainers (must be disclosed).

capabilities.description: What an agent can actually DO through this resource. Drives risk_class.

risk_class.description: R0 public read; R1 authenticated account read; R2 places/cancels orders; R3 moves funds (withdrawal/transfer).

status.description: active = verified working; watch = degraded/uncertain, under observation; deprecated = superseded; archived = kept for history only.

affiliation.description: Set when the resource is affiliated with the catalog maintainers (e.g. 'mossland'). Required whenever publisher_relation = maintainer.

last_verified_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) a human last confirmed the facts in this entry.

evidence_urls.description: One or more URLs that substantiate the claims in this entry.
